description: Quickest way to put a single number or value on the user's iPhone Home Screen / Lock Screen widget via WidgetDash, e.g. 'Stripe MRR = $12,400' or 'Open tickets = 7'. Sets one metric (matched by label) on a source, keeping the source's other metrics, title and icon; creates the source if it does not exist. Requires WIDGETDASH_WRITE_KEY.

category.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. 'finance', 'monitoring', 'fitness'. If omitted, keeps the existing category (default 'general').

color.description: Optional accent color (green/red/yellow/blue/gray/orange/purple/cyan); defaults to the existing metric's color.

display_name.description: Title shown on the widget, e.g. 'Stripe'. If omitted, keeps the existing name (or derives one from source_key for new sources).

icon.description: SF Symbol name shown next to the title, e.g. 'dollarsign.circle.fill', 'chart.bar.fill', 'server.rack', 'heart.fill', 'cart.fill'. If omitted, keeps the existing icon (default 'circle.fill').

label.description: Short label shown on the widget, e.g. 'MRR' or 'Users online'.

sort_order.description: Position for a NEW source among your sources (lower first, default 0). Ignored when updating an existing source: its order is set in the WidgetDash app.

source_key.description: Stable identifier for this data source, e.g. 'stripe_mrr' or 'server_health'. Lowercase letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Pushing to an existing key updates it; a new key creates a new widget source.

type.description: Optional; defaults to the existing metric's type, else inferred from the value.

value.description: The value to display, pre-formatted as you want it shown (e.g. '$12,400', '42', 'Healthy'). For 'progress' use 0-100; for 'timestamp' an ISO 8601 time or Unix epoch seconds.

name: push_number
title: Push one number to iPhone widget
